hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A DEX aggregator hook that intercepts swaps and re-routes them through the optimal combination of Uniswap V4 and V3 pools by sorting available liquidity sources by effective price. It uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta to capture the full swap delta, charges a service fee via poolManager.donate(), and restricts liquidity addition and pool initialization to a single hardcoded admin address.
